hero_kpi_rationale: Capex is the primary driver of capacity and fleet modernization, key for long-term competitiveness in the industry. AAL is making significant investments in acquiring new aircraft (737 MAX, A321XLR, 787-9) to improve operational efficiency and reduce unit costs.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount spent each year to purchase aircraft and modernize infrastructure.
kpis.description: Capex amounts to $3.8 Bn in 2025, compared to $2.7 Bn in 2024, primarily for the purchase of new aircraft such as the Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A321XLR.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in capex to renew the fleet.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow decreases to $3.1 Bn in 2025, from $4.0 Bn in 2024, due to lower profitability and working capital fluctuations.
kpis.signal: Decline in cash flow related to profitability and working capital.

kpis.name: Debt Repayment

kpis.description: Debt repayment reaches $5.5 Bn in 2025, compared to $4.5 Bn in 2024, including the early repayment of secured senior notes and convertible bonds.
